_readme: The repo-wide base layer of generic render knobs every dataset inherits (resolution order: CLI > datasets/<session>/<set>/recipe.json > this file). PENDING: the previous render-knob schema was wiped with the chain that produced it, and the tool-first render tier re-seeds this file with its own knob set + per-knob why-notes when its LADDER is built (BACKLOG:`render-ladder`). Kept as the placeholder base layer so the per-dataset state model stays intact.
